observed: After the final aspect toggle and first reference fit, data-moving is still true and target bounds retain the pre-toggle view. The following fit changes target bounds to the unlocked fitted curve. Reference is captured before the aspect action settles.
correction: Add unchecked assertion and the existing settled(page) after the final aspect toggle, before the reference fit. Preserve ten rapid fits, unchanged 0.25px tolerance and all other assertions. No product, domain, workflow, retry or timeout change.
